faqIntro: Thinking about publishing a book? Get clear answers to common questions authors ask before moving forward with the publishing process.

faq.q: How do I Publish book online?
faq.a: We prepare your manuscript, cover, formatting, and publishing files, then help move your title toward online publication and distribution.

faq.q: What do I need to get your book published?
faq.a: You generally need a completed manuscript, professional cover, interior formatting, ISBN, and publication-ready files. We can help coordinate the essential requirements.

faq.q: How does publishing a book work?
faq.a: It typically involves manuscript preparation, editing, design, formatting, ISBN setup, publication, and distribution. We help coordinate the important stages.

faq.q: How long does getting a book published take?
faq.a: The timeline varies according to your manuscript, design needs, formats, approvals, and selected publishing channels. We can help establish a realistic project timeline.

faq.q: Can I publish my book in paperback and hardcover?
faq.a: Yes. We can prepare your title for both paperback and hardcover editions, with the appropriate specifications and files for each.

faq.q: Can my book be published as an eBook?
faq.a: Yes. Your manuscript can be professionally prepared for eBook publication and made ready for supported digital platforms.

faq.q: Do I retain ownership of my book?
faq.a: Ownership depends on the terms of your publishing agreement. Review the agreement carefully so you understand the rights you retain and any rights you grant.
Yes. We can assist with ISBN requirements and help ensure the necessary publishing information is prepared correctly.

faq.q: Where can my published book be distributed?
faq.a: Depending on your selected options, your book can be made available through online bookstores, digital platforms, and broader distribution channels.
